{{Quote|Since you have the anti-virus I thought you might be interested in taking care of something slightly dangerous, but will help out the quarantine zone.|Oona Wran, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:QZVCD" />}}
'''Oona Wran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|If the virus canisters are destroyed we have a better chance of being rescued. If a rescue party manages to land or blast its way to rescue us, they have less of a chance of succumbing to the virus before we can provide an antidote...and if I die, which could happen any minute here.|Oona Wran, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:QZVCD" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Oona Wran was present on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] when an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]].<ref name="SWG:QZVCD" /> The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including Oona Wran,<ref name="SWG:QZVCD" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

During his time in the Quarantine Zone, Oona Wran discovered that canisters containing Blackwing virus were scattered throughout the zone during the outbreak. Furthermore, the canisters were leaking and releasing more virus in the area, representing a threat to the rescue teams landing in the area. The Bothan therefore visited four of the five refugee camp built by the survivors in the Quarantine Zone, [[Camp Alpha|Camps Alpha]], [[Camp Beta|Beta]], [[Camp Gamma|Gamma]] and [[Camp Delta|Delta]], to find assistance in destroying the canisters. Oona Wran recruited several spacers who ventured into the Quarantine Zone and provided them with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. The adventurers eventually succeeded in blowing up all the leaking canisters.<ref name="SWG:QZVCD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oona Wran was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:QZVCD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Oona Wran was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
